description.en: The ID of the API asset that you want to modify.

description.zh:
混合云集群 ID。
> 只针对混合云场景，您可以调用[DescribeHybridCloudClusters](~~2849376~~)获取混合云集群信息。
description.en:
The ID of the hybrid cloud cluster.

> This parameter is required only for hybrid cloud scenarios. You can call the [DescribeHybridCloudClusters](~~2849376~~) operation to query the ID of the hybrid cloud cluster.

description.zh:
是否关注。取值：
- **1**：表示关注。
- **0**：表示不关注（默认）。
description.en:
Indicates whether to follow the API asset. Valid values:

- **1**: follows the API asset.

- **0** (default): does not follow the API asset.

description.zh:
WAF实例的ID。

> 您可以调用[DescribeInstance](~~433756~~)获取当前WAF实例的ID。
description.en:
The ID of the WAF instance.

> You can call the [DescribeInstance](~~433756~~) operation to query the ID of the WAF instance.
The remarks of the API asset. You can use this parameter to add a custom annotation to the API asset for easier identification.

description.zh:
WAF实例所属地域。取值：

- **cn-hangzhou**：表示中国内地。

- **ap-southeast-1**：表示非中国内地。
description.en:
The region where the WAF instance resides. Valid values:

- **cn-hangzhou**: the Chinese mainland.

- **ap-southeast-1**: outside the Chinese mainland.
The ID of the Alibaba Cloud resource group to which the WAF instance belongs.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun waf-openapi modify-apisec-api-resource --instance-id waf_elasticity-cn-0xldbqt0000 --follow 0 --note know --api-id c68995b89069595c5c0399676f3ca64f --cluster-id 428 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --resource-manager-resource-group-id rg-acfm000q --api-version 2021-10-01 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun waf-openapi ModifyApisecApiResource --region cn-hangzhou --ResourceManagerResourceGroupId 'rg-acfm000q' --Follow 0 --InstanceId 'waf_elasticity-cn-0xldbqt0000' --ClusterId 428 --Note know --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --ApiId c68995b89069595c5c0399676f3ca64f
